fact: ADEA says Angola's Ministry of Education is advancing discussions on a comprehensive EMIS legal framework and a modernised National Education Management Information System, with the ESDC initiative aiming at a robust and sustainable EMIS.

The World Bank appraisal document says Component 3 of the TEST project (US$15m IBRD) modernises the higher education sector's Higher Education Management Information System (HEMIS), run through the higher education ministry MESCTI.
